title: PRIOS
description: This dataset contains intracranial EEG (ECoG) recordings from 6 epilepsy patients (ages 13-53) who underwent Cortico-Cortical Evoked Potential (CCEP) mapping via single pulse electrical stimulation (SPES), both in the awake state during clinical routine and under general propofol anesthesia. The data were collected to investigate the effect of propofol on local effective brain networks. Electrode positions were estimated using individual MRI-based Freesurfer reconstructions and co-registered to MNI305 space.
methods_description: CCEPs were recorded with ECoG during single pulse electrical stimulation (SPES) performed while patients were awake (clinical routine, SPES-clinical) and under general propofol anesthesia (SPES-propofol). Electrode positions were estimated using Freesurfer reconstructions of individual subject MRI scans and converted to MNI305 space via surface-based non-linear transformation.
